Brookfield's financial infrastructure arm is in exclusive discussions to buy fraud detection business Actimize, according to a Sky News report  on Wednesday, which cited unidentified sources.
The sources cautioned that a deal has yet to be completed and could still fall apart.

The update comes after Calcalist's CTech reported in May that five firms made bids for Actimize in the first round. The bidders included New Mountain Capital, Veritas Capital, Stone Point Capital, Advent International, and SymphonyAI.
Nice ADRs edged up by 0.8% on Wednesday.
